map.酶失活动力学：D 值为某温度下酶活降低 90% 所需时间；t = D_ref ×: Enzyme inactivation kinetics: the D value is the time needed at a given temperature for enzyme activity to fall by 90%; t = D_ref × n × 10^((T_ref − T)/Z), where n is the log reduction (n=3 means 99.9% inactivation). Common indicator enzymes: peroxidase (heat resistant, used as the marker for adequate blanching) and polyphenol oxidase (related to browning). Blanching also inactivates enzymes, keeps colour, softens texture and removes pesticide residues.

map.该温度 D 值 D_T = D_ref × 10^((T_ref − T)/Z): D value at that temperature D_T = D_ref × 10^((T_ref − T)/Z); the blanching time needed is t = D_T × n (n being the log inactivation).
map.过氧化物酶取 D_ref=0.5 min @100℃、Z=10、目标失活 n=3: Taking peroxidase with D_ref=0.5 min at 100°C, Z=10 and target inactivation n=3 (0.1% residual): at 95°C, D_T=0.5×10^0.5≈1.58 min, so t≈4.74 min reaches 99.9% inactivation.
map.Z 为 D 值变化 10 倍所需温度变化（℃），多数酶 Z≈8–12；温度越高: Z is the temperature change needed for a tenfold change in the D value (in °C); for most enzymes Z is about 8-12. The higher the temperature the smaller the D value and the faster the inactivation.
map.常规漂烫取 n=2–4（失活 99%–99.99%），绿叶菜常取 3 以兼顾护色: Routine blanching uses n=2-4 (99%-99.99% inactivation); leafy vegetables often use 3 to balance colour and texture.
